integrity: Pointwise combinatorial proof included. Finite exact-rational and numerical convex-hull checks support, but do not replace, proof. No independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Generic orthogonal shadows of complete parallel vertex truncations with \(t_i+t_j<1\) only; no assertion for merged cuts, arbitrary beveled normals or metric shadow statistics. The tetrahedral solid-angle law and its sharp range are previously known. Historical-priority risk persists for older unindexed silhouette literature.
title: Shadow-count complementarity under complete parallel truncation of a tetrahedron
